text:
incident-bot: P1 page: multiple regions reporting 5xx spikes and high latency for inference endpoints. Affected: eu-west-2 & eu-west-1 traffic skew. Pager sent to @sara_oncall and on-call rotation.

sara_oncall: Seeing ~40% 502/504s on /v1/generate across the board for customers pinned to eu-west-2. Some sessions drop mid-stream.

miguel_sre: I can confirm. ELB target health shows many targets healthy but connection resets from NLB -> instance. Hoping it's control-plane routing.

neha_prodeng: Customer impact: several mid-market tenants report degraded latency and errors for calls >2048 tokens. Ticket queue spiking.

alan_support: Noticing Route53 health checks for the regional edge are flapping: https://status.aws/route53 (internal note) — TTLs very low, TTL=10s for the test checks.

miguel_sre: Capturing logs now. Running tcpdump on a few affected hosts in eu-west-2a/b. Getting asymmetric syn-ack delays.

sara_oncall: Short term: shift traffic away from eu-west-2. I'll update routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for the next 10m. Can someone start an opsplay?

neha_prodeng: Opsplay: redirect via weighted Route53 policy (manual override) -> set eu-west-2 weight to 0, increase eu-west-1 weight. Also enable elastic fallback to dedicated pool in eu-central-1 for critical customers.

miguel_sre: Applying weighted policy now:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-2","Weight":0,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```

alan_support: Done. Support emailed customers with ETA ~30m and recommended re-try. Adding status page note. :loudspeaker:

incident-bot: Note: Incident created INC-2026-032-001, severity P1. Logging timeline and snapshots to /incidents/INC-2026-032-001.

miguel_sre: Observing fewer 5xx after weighted shift started ~1915000080. But still intermittent 504s for long-running streams where we proxied within AZ. Suspect ELB cross-AZ connection tracking issue.

neha_prodeng: Is EBS or EC2 underlying affected? Any underlying host health warnings?

miguel_sre: EC2 instance metrics look ok; EBS IOPS fine. ELB control plane shows elevated API error rates in eu-west-2 per AWS console. Opening AWS escalation.

aws-escalation-bot: AWS Support: Case 987654321 opened. Assigned to Network Ops. AWS acknowledges control plane routing anomalies for NLBs in region eu-west-2, working on mitigation.

sara_oncall: Good. For customer-facing mitigation we'll: 1) keep weight=0 for eu-west-2, 2) enforce health check grace on our side (increase initial_delay to 30s for short-term), 3) enable prefix KV cache to reduce long stream hits.

miguel_sre: Implementing health check grace: updating autoscaling target group health check matcher and deregistration delay to 60s.

neha_prodeng: Also enabling canary fallback: route small percentage (2%) to dedicated eu-central-1 pool to verify traffic behavior.

alan_support: Support noted that some customers still see reconnect loops due to client-side aggressive retries. Suggested guidance: set exponential backoff, 500-> retry with jitter. I'm posting a snippet to status page.

sara_oncall: On-call handover note: @miguel_sre will stay primary until AWS confirms control plane resolved. I'll pass to @miguel_sre in 25m if stable.

miguel_sre: Received handoff. Continuing monitoring dashboards (ELB/ALB/NLB, Route53 health checks, netstat on hosts). Creating a short-running synthetic test hitting long-stream endpoints every 10s.

incident-bot: Update: synthetic tests show success rate rising to 98% after routing shift. Monitoring for 15m before declaring degraded->mitigated.

neha_prodeng: Post-incident action items: - Confirm with AWS root cause and timeline. - Add runbook step for weighted-routing quick rollback. - Add alert to detect ELB control-plane API error rate >5% sustained.

miguel_sre: Filed RFC for automation: if route53 health checks flap >3 times in 5m and ELB API errors >3% -> auto-weight shift to other region and notify on-call.

alan_support: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~6 tenants saw >30% error rate for 18–28 minutes, one critical tenant had streaming sessions dropped repeatedly requiring manual replays. Estimated revenue impact: low-medium, SLA credit evaluation in progress.

aws-escalation-bot: AWS update: mitigation in progress; control plane issue root cause related to internal routing fabric in eu-west-2. No ETA yet, but mitigation steps taken.

miguel_sre: Marking incident as under control at 1915000386. Keeping postmortem open until AWS confirms root cause and until we complete runbook updates.

sara_oncall: Thanks team. Handoff complete. I'll file the incident postmortem draft and assign action items. :white_check_mark:
